title: Let's Curate
tagline: Collaborative, permissionless and trustless curation. XXXXXXXXXX
description:
This project allows its users to define what to curate and curate collaboratively. In doing so, agents do not need to trust each other or ask for permission to join this curation effort. Actors are incentivized to contribute and contribute honestly.

The project is unfortunately incomplete, we were not quick enough.
how_its_made:
We designed a game (in the sense of game theory) where the best strategy is to play honestly. The game leverages the Schelling Point principle and probability theory.
